target_customer: Hardware startups and product teams needing certification such as FCC, CE and UL
problem: Hardware certification and testing is slow and paper heavy, delaying market launch.
business_model: Compliance as a service with AI agents and expert review, pricing not found

founders.name: Tony Gao
founders.background_notes: Education from the YC profile tagline. A third party review said it could not verify hardware or compliance experience.

competitors.name: Normal
competitors.what: Vanta for hardware certification platform supporting FCC, ISED, CE and ASTM
competitors.traction_then: Two person team in YC Summer 2025, says it takes teams from zero to certified in weeks

competitors.name: HardwareCompliance
competitors.what: AI agents for FCC, CE, UL, FDA 510(k) and other certifications

technical_complexity.rationale: Mapping standards and drafting technical files is document work for LLMs. Real certification still depends on accredited test labs.

defensibility.rationale: Lab relationships and traceable records help, but at least two other AI compliance startups launched earlier or at the same time.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet known; startups with the same pitch exist but no acquisition or copying reported.

market_need_then: Hardware teams depend on slow lab processes; several startups pitched the same Vanta for hardware angle in 2025 and 2026, suggesting investor belief in the need. No customer spend data found.

branding.domain_note: Uses getfuchsia.ai with a get prefix and .ai. The earlier name Noetic used getnoetic.ai.

rebrands.why: Not stated; per StartupHub it shipped as Noetic through Demo Day and renamed shortly after

brand_strength.rationale: Name collides with Google's Fuchsia operating system so search results are dominated by it, and the rebrand lost the earlier name's early press.

outcome_analysis: Fuchsia, previously Noetic, is a Spring 2026 company and active, with no exit or shutdown found. Funding is only seen on aggregators. It competes with Normal, which started earlier, so its path depends on faster certification outcomes and lab partnerships.
notes: Unverified: FundedIQ lists a 500k dollar pre-seed in June 2026 and VCBacked lists Y Combinator as investor; single aggregator, so no round recorded. getfuchsia.ai could not be fetched because the safety check was rate limited, not because the site is dead. Team size is 1 on one YC page and 3 on another. The Vanta for hardware phrase is also used by Normal, Noetic and Saphira AI. Completeness pass: the pre-seed (June 2026, Y Combinator) rests on a single database (VCBacked, no amount); FundedIQ gives 500K but its page was not opened. Searches found no press.
